title: Personal Agent — Base Instance Record
description: Unified base record that every user.* instance record extends. Resolves field drift between v0.1/v0.2 packs (score→confidence; claim/rule_statement/instruction/output_rule→statement). Spec: spec/01-kernel-schema.md §7.

id.description: Stable record id, format <subject>.<recordkind>.NNN e.g. logotekton.role.001

record_type.description: Pack-specific record type enum (defined by each user.* schema).

statement.description: The scoped claim/rule/instruction in behavioral language. Canonical field name; a pack may document a display alias (rule_statement, instruction, output_rule).

evidence_refs.description: ≥1 EvidenceItem id/ref. Gate G1: no evidence-free claim. NOTE on machine-check scope: validate_packs / convergence_report verify that this list is present and contains ≥1 non-empty string (G1 presence). Resolving each ref to a real EvidenceItem (rejecting a dangling/fabricated id) requires an EvidenceItem registry the file-based model does not yet carry — that resolution is future work / a governance step, so traceability=1.0 currently certifies presence, not resolution.

scope.description: Where/when this record applies. Gate G2: no unscoped record.

review_status.description: Lifecycle state. Gate G3: only confirmed/narrowed/edited are runtime-active.

sensitivity.description: Privacy class. sensitive/restricted require a BoundaryRule before promotion (Gate G5).

auto_confirmed.description: True if this record reached review_status=confirmed via an auto_confirm_policy (spec/12) rather than a human gate. Default false = human-confirmed. The maturity gate counts a human-only human_confirmation_ratio that EXCLUDES auto_confirmed records, so auto-confirm cannot inflate the confirmed numerator and let the system self-certify its own maturity (spec/12 §4.4 circularity break).

reliability.description: Evidence CHANNEL of this record — which claim layer it belongs to (spec/01 §7.1, spec/00 claim-layer note). behavioral = derived from observed behavior, artifacts, or corrections (Gate G4) — the trusted default that earns runtime authority and counts toward maturity DEPTH. self_reported = the subject described themselves in words ('I'm a careful reviewer'); it is a LOW-TRUST tier kept so an interior/motivational signal can be CARRIED without being mistaken for behavioral evidence. A self_reported record (1) MUST NOT be auto_confirmed (allOf below, enforced by validate_packs.py), (2) stays draft-only — it does NOT count toward ANY maturity index (convergence_report.py excludes it from all six convergence indices — coverage/depth, confirmation_ratio, decision_fidelity, correction_cost, drift_stability, traceability — plus the gate variant human_confirmation_ratio and the seeded breadth count) and is excluded from authoritative runtime context by the selection predicate (context_select.py; live compiler wiring pending, #9), and (3) is an InterpretationClaim about the self, not an OriginalClaim of behavior. Absent = behavioral. This is the structural break between the evidence layer and the application/interpretation layer.

review_audit.description: Provenance of the human review that promoted this record (Karpathy #8): makes a real review mechanically distinguishable from a rubber-stamp and lets edit_rate be computed. validate_packs --require-audit makes it mandatory on runtime-active records.

reviewer_id.description: Who decided (a UserSubject/handle), not just that someone did.

decision.description: The review action taken. 'edit' distinguishes a corrected record from a rubber-stamped 'confirm' — the signal for edit_rate / correction_strength.

decision_reason.description: Why — a one-line rationale, so the decision is auditable.

diff.description: before→after of the change when decision=edit.

board_id.description: The review board/session this decision belongs to.

exception_rules.description: On-record list of the boundary exceptions/conditions under which a sensitive/restricted record may be used (the machine-checkable G5 proxy: required when sensitivity ∈ {sensitive, restricted}, enforced by the allOf below and tools/validate_packs.py). NOTE: the validator checks only that this field is present and non-empty; verifying each entry corresponds to a confirmed BoundaryRule in user.boundary_authority is a governance/review step, not yet machine-enforced.

canonical_key.description: Semantic identity for dedup/merge: a stable key over target_pack · record_type · normalize(statement) · scope. Records sharing a canonical_key are the SAME record and are upserted (merged), not appended as twins. Spec: spec/10-dedup-and-merge.md §2.

repetition_count.description: How many times this record's pattern has been (re-)derived and merged in. A confidence input (more support → higher confidence, capped by counterexamples); merging is idempotent. Default 1. Spec: spec/10-dedup-and-merge.md §4.

merge_history.description: Ids of candidates/evidence merged into this record over time — the provenance trail of the accumulation.

$comment: confirmed required before strong runtime use; broad records require repeated support or explicit confirmation (enforced by tools/validate_packs.py with context).
